title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E04 — Nightmare on Fremont Street
A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E03 — Sex, Lies and Surveillance Tape
A hotel guest reports a theft that launches an investigation with security and Metro detectives, but the truth proves to be far more scandalous.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E02 — Big Bang Theories
Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E01 — The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky
As the Golden Nugget's busiest season begins, tempers flare at check-in; a swiped $1,000 chip sparks a hotel-wide high-tech hunt; surveillance targets a team of card counters; and a VIP host gets creative to keep his client gambling.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E05 — Till Death Do Us Shark
Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E08 — Just Doing My Duty
Each year, CBP recovers over 1,300 stolen vehicles at ports of entry. Many are heading to the black market, while cartels use others for trafficking. When officers receive a be on the lookout (BOLO) alert for a luxury car, they take it seriously.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E01 — Tramadol to Hell
A driver claims he buys used cars over the border to import into the U.S., but an X-ray reveals something hidden in his spare tire; when a traveler returning from Mexico declares snacks at customs, a fish and wildlife expert is called in.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E04 — The Meth Doesn't Add Up
During his first day on the job, a rookie officer relies on his training, sending a hesitant driver for further inspection, and his hunch pays off; when a traveler claims to be visiting his dentist bimonthly in Mexico, officers investigate further.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E05 — Roses in Red, Violence in Blue
A traveler is caught with blades for cockfighting, a cartel-run blood sport; every year, Mexico grows millions of dollars of flowers for the U.S., but cartels are taking advantage of the influx of shipments during major holidays.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E03 — The Breeder's Cup
Officers find an 18-wheeler carrying more than a load of takeout containers; a couple raises suspicion after declaring bulldog semen, but the labeling suggests the box may actually contain stallion semen, a valuable and tightly regulated substance.

title: All Access PD: Grand Rapids
description:
S01 E04 — Cemetery
What seemed like an accidental overdose becomes a murder investigation when a jail informant tips off Grand Rapids detectives; conflicting witness accounts leave the detectives searching for hard evidence to solve Dana's death.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E02 — Tangipahoa Parish Jail
In Bloody Tangipahoa, a new sheriff takes on a parish defined by violence, fighting to pull a crumbling, neglected jail back from the brink while inmates work to rebuild the family bonds that could keep them from coming back.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E08 — Washoe County Jail
Inside one of Nevada's busiest jails, deputies battle a non-stop surge of arrests driven by Reno's constant crime and a major trafficking corridor; with gangs entrenched inside, keeping rival groups apart becomes a daily fight for control.

description:
S12 E04 — Sea-ing Red
Pressure mounts as a Nome-wide diver shortage forces Chris McCully into a dangerous solo dive and Emily's crew into river dredging; the Kellys fight over the lack of progress on their newest dredge, the All-In.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E01 — Kings of the Frozen North
The captains find a rare strain of red king crab in the north amid ice and storms; Sig deploys an underwater drone to pinpoint the horde; Jake revives the Cornelia Marie to battle northern seas.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E02 — Headlong Into Halong
With no port for shelter, Johnathan fights to protect his crew as Typhoon Halong pounds the northern grounds; Rick's Red King jackpot halts when a line fouls his prop.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E09 — Family Feud
Families bring their inherited moonshine recipes to the Master Distiller arena; when couples, siblings, and a father-son team fire up stills together under the pressure of a ticking clock, sparks fly.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E02 — Big Box Store Showdown
Two moonshiners and a pro distiller face off in a big-box store challenge; with just three minutes to shop the discount aisles, each must turn bulk buys into a working mash then distill it into high-proof liquor.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E19 — Delicious But Expired
Digger takes three distillers to a local farm to select ingredients for their mash from containers of expired produce; with Mark and Tim joining at the judges table, competitors fire up their stills to turn culled crops into top shelf spirits.

title: Moonshiners: Master Distiller
description:
S05 E04 — Tim's Thanksgiving Throwdown
When Tim announces the first Thanksgiving actually took place in Virginia, Tickle smokes a Virginia ham in honor of the occasion; champions Amanda, Richard and Daniel face off to run the best holiday liquor to complete the Thanksgiving feast.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S01 E02 — Pappygate Conspiracy
Tim, Tickle, Mark and Digger investigate notorious crimes from the moonshine underworld to uncover the secrets, syndicates, mayhem and murder at the fringes of America's centuries-old backwoods tradition.

title: Moonshiners
description:
The Real McCoy
Moonshiners Mark, Digger and Tim delve deep into the case of the most prolific and elusive bootlegger of the Prohibition era; declared Public Enemy Number One by the government, Bill McCoy's mission was about a lot more than just fame and fortune.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S01 E07 — Caught in the Act
Tim, Tickle, Mark and Digger deploy hard-won lessons from backwoods tradition to get away with making and bootlegging illegal moonshine.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E02 — Stranger Danger
Tim and Tickle's tariff-dodging operation is threatened when a stranger appears at their still site; Mark and Digger face buyer's remorse over their $70K corn purchase; Jerry reaches his breaking point when Mike's $4K moonshine deal goes south.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E03 — Mine and Shine
Josh invests money he doesn't yet have to build a still site that doubles as a gold mine; Mark enlists Amanda and Kelly to distill liquor from surplus soybeans to prove Digger wrong.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E04 — Digger Knows Best
Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E05 — Hillbilly Scotch
Josh's head spins when Jerry reveals his wild plans for their joint moonshine operation. Mark and Digger enlist a Scotsman to help craft the first Hillbilly Scotch.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E06 — Up in Smoke
When their hillbilly scotch experiment flames out, Mark and Digger light a fire under their still hand, Kelly. Josh's lucrative 80-gallon moonshine order rides on Jerry's unproven vacuum still experiment. Mike devises a recipe to poach Jerry's buyer.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S01 E02 — Nazi Toxic Hell Sub
A sunken Nazi submarine packed with toxic cargo is a ticking time bomb that could put the whole world at risk; Jeremy Wade reveals the sub's top-secret mission it was on when it sank and how experts keep it from sparking a global catastrophe.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S01 E08 — NASA's Lost Treasure
Jeremy Wade investigates the whereabouts of a lost relic of the Space Age that tarnished the reputation of NASA's first astronauts; cutting-edge technology turns up brand-new evidence that might finally vindicate this American hero.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E02 — Polar Extremes
Josh Gates tackles history's most chilling polar adventures, including Robert Peary and Matthew Henson's brave push to the North Pole as well as Ernest Shackleton's epic survival in Antarctic ice.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E01 — Highest Highs, Lowest Lows
Josh Gates recounts the death-defying exploits of Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay, who summit Mount Everest; two submariners plunge seven miles under the Pacific; a pilot skydives from the edge of space.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E04 — Wild Rides
Josh Gates explores daring journeys, including the Kon-Tiki balsa raft crossing the Pacific, NASA's lunar rover making tracks on the moon and an airplane flying around the world without the use of fuel.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E06 — Explorer's Club at the Movies
Josh Gates explores how club members' swashbuckling exploits inspired Hollywood; a bullwhip-cracking archaeologist may be the real-life Indiana Jones; a Nazi mountaineer's life-changing "Seven Years in Tibet" became a Brad Pitt star turn.

title: Tales From the Explorers Club
description:
S01 E03 — The Race to Space
Josh Gates boldly explores members' most heart-pounding journeys into space; Apollo 13 astronauts fight to bring their crippled spacecraft 238,000 miles back to Earth and futuristic SpaceShipOne could give others a chance to travel to space.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S02 E01 — Conspiracy Theories
Josh Gates investigates conspiracy theories, including new discoveries suggesting the Titanic was sunk by more than just an iceberg, the true story behind the death of Harry Houdini and lost Civil War gold that spawned a lawsuit against the FBI.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S02 E05 — Mysterious Phenomena
Josh Gates looks closely at some of history's most intriguing hoaxes and unexplained events, including the Amityville Horror, the strange fate of a military submarine crew, and a phenomenon in which people's body fat causes them to burn alive.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E07 — Truth Vs. Tabloids
Josh Gates investigates sensationalistic stories, seeking the truth behind the unexplained: rock legend Jim Morrison's death, a bizarre, preserved mermaid found in a Japanese temple, and claims of alien abduction from a U.S. Airman.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E03 — Fateful Coverups
From a secret World War II unit that deceived Nazis, to the alleged crimes of the Knights Templar and a royal death tied to a scandal, Josh Gates explores mysteries built on coverups; was the truth buried to protect power, reputation and empires?

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E01 — Mysteries of American History
Josh Gates explores American history, including a theory that John Wilkes Booth escaped justice -- only to meet a stranger fate; learn myth-busting truths behind Paul Revere's midnight ride and a U.S. Navy sub that vanished in the Cold War.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E01 — Missing Heroes of WW2
Josh investigates America's daring response to Pearl Harbor, which destroyed a vital Japanese base in the South Pacific; using brand-new intel, Josh dives in with Project Recover to find 40 planes and 200 American heroes lost in Operation Hailstone.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E02 — Finding the Lost Pilots of WW2
Josh dives deep into the Navy's Pearl Harbor counterattack, uncovering an eyewitness who shares details of American soldiers' executions; new intel leads to the discovery of the first U.S. plane ever found from this battle.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S09 E02 — The Lost Avenger
A three-man crew of Navy pilots training for World War II crashed into the Pacific Ocean 75 years ago; Josh Gates teams up with Project Recover on a daring mission to find the plane and bring closure for the three souls who have never been found.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S06 E08 — America's Lost WWII Hero
Josh Gates explores the case of WASP pilot Gertrude "Tommy" Tompkins who went missing in her P-51 Mustang during World War II; Josh joins search teams using modern technology to locate Tompkins' lost aircraft.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S08 E05 — The Warrior Queen's Treasure
Josh Gates takes on the Indian Ocean's punishing waters as he chases a lost treasure that is rumored to be worth more than $1 billion.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Josh's Favorites: Searching for World War II's Lost Hero
Armed with a new eyewitness account and cutting-edge tech, Josh travels to Micronesia and dives the Pacific to find a lost P-47 Thunderbolt. Piloted by an American hero, the plane took part in a daring raid during the final days of World War II.

title: Monsters Inside Me
description:
S09 E01 — What's Feeding on You?
Revealing an extraordinary medical first, a woman pulls live worms from her eye; a hunter discovers that a tick bite has turned eating everyday food into a dangerous gamble; a woman returns from Hawaii with parasites attacking her nervous system.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S09 E06 — America's Titanic
Josh dives the Atlantic in search of millions in lost coins that sunk with America's Titanic.

S07 E03 — Secrets of Mafia Island
A Mediterranean island paradise is not all that it seems; a complex of abandoned buildings once served to imprison the world's most dangerous Mafiosi; experts reveal who was imprisoned here and the secrets they left behind.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E08 — Ruins of the Rust Belt
A complex of tall, windowless buildings in the American Rust Belt hold the secrets to a lost empire of industry and wealth; experts investigate these mysterious structures to reveal why this once powerful metropolis is now home to abandoned ruins.

description:
S02 E07 — Matt's National Treasure Hunt
Matt chases a rare copy of the Declaration of Independence in a hoard; he digs through a 4,000-square-foot chicken coop for vintage motorcycles; a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine could be a big find if they can get it out of the chicken coop.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:

The team pulls 50,000 pounds of trash from a hoarder's Tennessee farmhouse. A safe could hold a generational jewelry collection.

title: Filthy Fortunes

A New York City home features self-lacing sneakers worth up to $100,000, mint-condition Knight Rider toys and hip-hop tour jackets.

S02 E03 — Matt's Michigan Magic
A widower's home is so dangerously packed and impassable that his family will no longer visit.

title: Filthy Fortunes

Matt hunts for rare liquor, hand-rolled cigars and vintage drums in two California hoards; when the owners refuse to part with key items, Matt's bottom line is threatened.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E07 — On a Mission for G.I. Dough
Matt and his troops head to the Pacific Northwest to search a three-barn hoard loaded with U.S. military treasures, including Willy's Jeeps and uniforms; a biohazard mess hides first-generation computers and video equipment at a second location.

The team tests if NASA really did land on the Moon.

Adam and Jamie take a fan mail film and use it to dial in on a phone book fable; the rest of the team test a fishy tale of Hollywood pyrotechnics with their own big bang theories.

The MythBusters go to the Indianapolis Motor Speedway to test racing myths.

Adam and Jamie test whether hands-free driving is a safe way to make a call while behind the wheel.

title: MythBusters

S18 E02 — Flights of Fantasy
Stow your tray tables because in this aviation extravaganza Adam and Jamie tackle two flights of fantasy.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E11 — Car vs. Rain
Adam and Jamie test out theories surrounding driving in the rain; they find out whether it is possible to stay dry by putting pedal to the metal.
